record.what_it_does: Corporate cards, spend management, expenses, bill pay and business banking platform.
record.auth_notes: User token (Bearer): created by an account admin or card admin under Developer > Settings with chosen scopes. It expires after 90 days unused or when the user becomes inactive. Partner OAuth2: Authorization Code Grant (PKCE optional) for all APIs except onboarding, which uses Client Credentials. The client ID and secret are issued by Brex developer support. The remote MCP server uses OAuth with Dynamic Client Registration (RFC 7591), so its clients need no pre-registration.
record.access_notes: The API itself comes with the free Essentials plan ($0/user/month; the pricing page lists "Brex API access"). Any Brex customer's admin can self-create a user token after accepting the developer API agreement. A Brex business account is still required. Multi-tenant OAuth apps need a client ID and secret that only Brex developer support issues (the partner route). Customer tokens are production-only. Partners get a staging environment.
record.api_breadth_notes: 10 APIs: Accounting, Budgets, Expenses, Fields, Onboarding, Payments, Team, Transactions, Travel and Webhooks. The Webhooks API alone has 13 operations: subscriptions, secrets and groups. The full operation count was not tallied but is very likely 50+.
record.mcp_notes: https://api.brex.com/mcp (Beta). Uses OAuth with DCR. An account or card admin must accept the Developer API agreement and enable the "Brex in AI assistants" beta under Settings → Beta features.
record.blocker_notes: A multi-user OAuth toolkit needs partner client credentials from Brex developer support. Fallback: each customer pastes an admin-created user token, which works on the free Essentials plan but only for Brex customers. The staging sandbox is only for partners, has no availability guarantees and may be purged. The customer API is production-only. The official MCP (OAuth + DCR) is beta and must be enabled per company.

evidence.quote: User tokens will expire if they are not used to make an API call for 90 days.
Brex currently only offers a production API server
For all other APIs, you will implement the Authorization Code Grant
The server supports Dynamic Client Registration (RFC 7591), so MCP clients don't need to be pre-registered.
The server is hosted at https://api.brex.com/mcp
Use staging for point-in-time testing only.

record.needs_human: Choosing between access=partner_gated and self_serve_free is a judgment call. Brex customers get API access free on Essentials, but public multi-user OAuth needs credentials from developer support. Check how long partner onboarding takes and whether a non-customer developer can get staging access.
